depth_contract.existing_receiver_parent_rule: Receiver only: max(nominal ground-depth z, matching existing foreground receiver z + 1). Canopy depth is unchanged.

prop_loop_contract.format: Use each entry blend and alpha: RGB on black for plus-lighter, straight RGBA for source-over.
prop_loop_contract.playback: frame = floor(elapsedSeconds * fps) % frames; source cell (frame % columns, floor(frame / columns)).
prop_loop_contract.resolution: All rects, frame_width/frame_height and z_index use the 1920x1080 coordinate system. @2x doubles each cell and the sheet, not CSS placement.
prop_loop_contract.sorting: Insert each crop at its z_index in the same walker/prop stack, immediately above its listed parent_slices. Do not place below occluder sprites.
prop_loop_contract.phase: Use per-entry fps/frames, including one-cell steady entries and six-second 12fps water/bulbs; do not assume a common sheet length.
prop_loop_contract.fallback: Pause at any cell for reduced motion. Omit sheets if unsupported; the static props remain complete.
prop_loop_contract.popcorn: Native 2x Cycles geometry, rotating lobed kernels on periodic arcs, attenuated through the existing glass and occluded by kettle/cabinet geometry.
prop_loop_contract.signs: Three menu backlights, soda logo and selections, a single E in TICKETS, and original INSERT COIN arcade pixel art.
